questions: what is next on the roadmap
answers.answer: The next step on the roadmap is to review the current project status, finish the highest-priority incomplete task, test that task, and document the result before adding another major feature.

questions: how do i check for updates
how do i update network assistant
answers.answer: In Network Assistant AI, enter: check updates. After the update finishes, refresh the page and enter: version.

questions: how do i check pending questions
how do i answer a pending question
answers.answer: In Network Assistant AI, enter: pending questions. Then use: open question NUMBER. To answer it, use: answer question NUMBER YOUR ANSWER.
